text_block_list.text:
It happened on the way back from going out 
with Wonder Acute.
(Grumbleee...)

Maybe because I walked so much, I've 
gotten really hungry...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you must be hungry. Shall we grab 
something to eat before heading home~?
choice_data_list:
...Would it be alright if I took you up on 
that?

text_block_list.text:
Entering a nearby shop— I met two 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that you two are here for the 
limited-edition apple pie as well?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A limited-edition apple pie? My, is there 
really such a thing?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That looks delicious. Maybe I'll have 
that, too. What about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try that one too.
Maybe I'll go with that too.

text_block_list.text:
Tempted by the words "limited edition," I 
decided to buy an apple pie along with one 
for Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~♪ It's so piping hot~. Crispy, warm, 
and delicious~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it smells nice, doesn't it? I 
wonder what scent this is?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it... maybe this is nutmeg?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nutmeg? Wait... was that a spice or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Was that how it was? It's often used in 
sweets, you see. The sweet aroma pairs so 
well with their sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It has a slight bitterness to it, so it's 
just right for adults to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I remember bringing nutmeg cookies as a 
treat for the neighborhood grandpas and 
grandmas a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Everyone ate it with such relish... It was 
a huge hit, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I can totally picture it. It's like a 
taste of nostalgia, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right~. Just thinking about it 
gives me a nice, warm feeling inside.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, I wonder if 
that cherry pie had a hint of nutmeg like 
this too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Long, looong ago, my family and I had pie 
at some cake shop, you see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sweet-and-sour, gooey cherries on a crispy 
crust, with a gentle hint of nutmeg in the 
air...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"It's a nostalgic, heartwarming flavor. 
Just thinking about it makes me crave 
some~"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if it's Acute-san's favorite, it's 
bound to be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, feels like it'll bring good 
fortune! Now I want to eat it too! You're 
curious about it too, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Is that true? That makes me happy~"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, which shop was that again...? It's 
been so long, I don't quite remember.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That flavor... since it's so good, I'd 
really love for everyone to try it.
choice_data_list:
Do you think you could recreate that 
flavor?

Don't you think you could recreate that 
flavor?

Impressive that you could tell the 
ingredients just from the taste.

Impressive that you could tell the 
ingredients just from the taste.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That flavor... since it's so good, I'd 
really love for everyone to try it.
choice_data_list:
Do you think you could recreate that 
flavor?

Don't you think you could recreate that 
flavor?

Impressive that you could tell the 
ingredients just from the taste.

Impressive that you could tell the 
ingredients just from the taste.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that might just be true, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If everyone will eat it, perhaps I'll 
give it a try just once."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still... please forgive me if it just ends 
up tasting the same as usual, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because I'm used to making 
it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nutmeg, cinnamon, and cloves. All of them 
are so handy for making sweets.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can pretty much tell just by 
the smell. Call it life's little wisdom. 
Fufufu.
